audience: practice managers and front-desk staff who manage schedules and staff in Akute Health

useCases.title: Find open appointment slots for a practitioner
useCases.text: The AI finds a practitioner and reads their open appointment slots between two date-times, so you can see when they can take visits.

useCases.title: Compare your appointment types
useCases.text: The AI lists the practice's appointment types with name, duration, video flag, who can book and the practitioners, so you can see what the practice offers.

useCases.title: List practice staff and their roles
useCases.text: The AI lists the practice's users with name, NPI and roles such as Practitioner, Prescriber, Staff or Admin, and opens one user for details.
